civic.name: Civic service participant
civic.role: Resident or community member navigating a public service
civic.context: Interacts with institutions under varying levels of time, trust, access, and administrative burden.
jobs: Complete a public-service task with minimal avoidable burden

sustainability.name: Sustainability program lead
sustainability.role: Turns broad commitments into measurable programs and reporting
sustainability.context: Coordinates across functions while evidence quality, incentives, and stakeholder expectations vary.

research.name: Applied research lead
research.context: Balances methodological rigor, practical constraints, reproducibility, and stakeholder use.

technical_content.name: Technical content lead
technical_content.role: Explains complex products, systems, or developer workflows
technical_content.context: Works between subject-matter experts, product teams, and users with different levels of expertise.
jobs: Keep documentation aligned with changing systems

institutional.name: Institutional decision owner
institutional.role: Coordinates policy, governance, funding, or operational decisions
institutional.context: Must reconcile mandates, risk, evidence, public accountability, and implementation capacity.

public_interest.name: Public-interest practitioner
public_interest.role: Works on social, environmental, or community outcomes
public_interest.context: Operates where affected groups, funders, institutions, and evidence standards may pull in different directions.
